summary: Raised the default ICARUS warm-up target from 1,200 to 5,000 chart bars, added truthful loaded/target/source telemetry, and wired NQ 20m warm-up to the repository's >10k-bar bundled MNQ 20m archive when no exact operator history export exists.
notes: The previous 'Hist. pieces' tile counted closed historical trade pieces, not historical bars.
Provider limits can cap network-only history below the requested target; the UI reports actual loaded depth rather than fabricating the target.
The bundled MNQ archive is used only as NQ 20m price-history warm-up fallback and its source is surfaced to the operator.
